name: ai-patrol
title: AI pilot: patrol among the rocks
description: An AI Gunship 2 in Ignoring mode flies a looping route of five waypoints through the rubble asteroids, steering round any rock in its way, and pays the player no attention. It plans its speed so it can turn round and brake in time, and passes through waypoints on a loop without stopping. Turn on the AI plans overlay to see its route, where it is heading and what it is steering round. Sliders: AI flight skill and cruise speed.

ui.lookFor: The AI ship (e1) patrols a loop through the asteroids on its own, steering round rocks and ignoring you. Turn on the AI plans overlay: rings are its waypoints, the dashed line where it is heading, a red ring what it is steering round. Fly into its path and it will avoid you, but not otherwise react.
